title: The hidden cost of cloud computing nobody talks about

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What hidden cost of cloud computing might shape our future in ways we’re not prepared for?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current tech allows infinite scalability, but energy use and rare-earth mining for servers are growing rapidly.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This strains ecosystems and displaces communities near mining sites, with little global accountability.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are testing liquid cooling and modular data centers to cut energy use and localize footprints.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If adopted widely, these could enable fairer resource distribution and more sustainable cloud infrastructures.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of cloud computing depends on aligning innovation with ecological and social responsibility.

video_cue: A close-up of a modular data center being assembled in a remote, green energy-powered facility.
